instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
2. Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
3. Rotate your palms to face forward and press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
4. Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending the elbows, then extend your arms back overhead.
5. Reverse the press to bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders, then lower to your sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move through each phase with control, no swinging.
2. Keep your core braced to protect your lower back during the overhead phases.
3. Keep elbows pointing forward during the triceps extension.
4. Exhale as you press overhead, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
3. Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, rotating your palms to face up at the top.
4. Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the start, rotating to a neutral grip.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move in a controlled manner, no swinging or jerking.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body and stop them from flaring out.
3. Keep your wrists straight.
4. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
3. Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder, rotating your palm to face up at the top.
4. Squeeze the biceps briefly, then lower the dumbbell slowly back to the start.
5. Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move in a controlled manner, no swinging or jerking.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body and stop them from flaring out.
3. Keep your wrists straight.
4. Brace your core to stop your torso from rocking side to side.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step your right leg behind and across to the left of your left leg.
3. Lower your hips until your back knee hovers just above the floor.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the start.
5. Repeat with the left leg stepping behind and across, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core braced for balance.
2. Move with control, focusing on stability.
3. Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, not collapsing inward.
4. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, elbows bent, palms facing forward.
2. Press the left dumbbell up until your arm is straight while keeping the right at chest level.
3. Lower the left dumbbell back to the start.
4. Press the right dumbbell up until your arm is straight, then lower it back.
5. Keep alternating arms with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
2. Move slowly and under control.
3. Keep your core tight to stay stable as one arm presses.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
